name: Brayden
design: A man in his late twenties with a loud, bright, energetic American voice, fast and punchy, smiling as he talks, like a fitness influencer filming himself on his phone at sunrise. Supremely confident and completely sincere, hyped, never sarcastic, never ironic.
ref_text: Good morning, team! It's four a.m. and I've already crushed three goals. Winners don't sleep in. Winners don't even sleep. Let's go!
design_DE: An adult man in his late twenties with a full, deep-chested, masculine American voice, a confident baritone, loud and energetic, fast and punchy, smiling as he talks, like a gym influencer filming himself at sunrise. Completely sincere and hyped, never sarcastic.
